Intended use: Estimate on-site hours for a new job to size slots; p10/p90 for schedule buffers.
Data: Synthetic jobs, time split (1350 train / 450 test). Features known at intake only: category, urgency, asset_type, tenant_id, asset_age_years, engineer_experience_years, hour, dayofweek, month, has_error_code, desc_len
Registry: promoted v1 to champion (mae=0.6202 vs None)
Limitations: Engineer experience is assumed known at booking (assigned engineer).
No travel time; add route-distance features for real scheduling.
Quantile crossing is possible; clip p10 <= p50 <= p90 at serve time.
Serve intervals as [p10 - 0.26, p90 + 0.26] (conformal offset); recalibrate monthly.
